records.real_world_identity_notes: The observation matches the Lotus Type 23, Lotus's small-capacity two-seat sports racer purpose-built for FIA Group 4 in 1962-1963. The proposed identity is the existing lotus-23 record, not the related single-seat Type 22 Formula Junior, the later reinforced 23B, or the wider-tired 23C. The Type 23 could carry different period gearbox installations, including Renault or Volkswagen-based units, so the real-car construction and some running-shift technique remain deliberately unresolved.
records.confidence_basis: Lotus's own heritage page identifies the Type 23 as a 1962 two-seat sports racer purpose-built for FIA Group 4 and describes its Renault or Volkswagen gearbox options. The exact AMS2 telemetry identity is Lotus 23, the related curated lead is an exact identity match, and the observed four-speed H-pattern implementation is consistent with the documented early Type 23 specification.

records.specification_basis: The period specification describes a Renault or Volkswagen-based four-speed unit, and the exact AMS2 implementation exposes four forward gears. Later Type 23-family installations could differ, so this is retained as the observed early/base configuration rather than generalized to every 23B or 23C. The period description places gear levers in the cockpit and describes a manual four-speed gearbox; the exact implementation is directly observed as H-pattern. No paddle or automatic interface is evidenced. The period specification explicitly identifies a mechanical Ford clutch in the power-transmission path of the early manual Type 23. That establishes a physical clutch control for moving off, while not proving the clutch technique used for every running shift. The reviewed specification describes a conventional manual clutch-and-gearbox upshift path and does not identify a driver blip as an upshift control; manual blipping is treated as not applicable to this path. The full-resolution exact Type 23 wheel image shows a continuous circular rim rather than fixed molded GT/formula grips or a flattened D-shaped band. The full-resolution wheel image shows a plain three-spoke wheel and no readout embedded in the rim. The full-resolution wheel image shows no shift/rev-light strip or light elements on the rim. The full-resolution wheel image shows the upper rim as a continuous intact band. The reviewed sources did not establish the remaining technique and wheel fields, which stay unknown in the real-car baseline: /authentic_controls/transmission/gearbox_type, /authentic_controls/transmission/shift_pattern, /authentic_controls/transmission/upshift/clutch, /authentic_controls/transmission/upshift/throttle_lift, /authentic_controls/transmission/upshift/automatic_cut, /authentic_controls/transmission/upshift/automatic_blip, /authentic_controls/transmission/downshift/clutch, /authentic_controls/transmission/downshift/throttle_lift, /authentic_controls/transmission/downshift/automatic_cut, /authentic_controls/transmission/downshift/manual_blip, /authentic_controls/transmission/downshift/automatic_blip.

correct_existing_simulator.basis: Repeat guided drive ams2.lotus-23.20260828t205725996z-e14bbb93 materially changed the reviewed AMS2 result: /overrides/authentic_controls/transmission/downshift/manual_blip from {'absent': True} to 'required'.
